## CredentialsModule.offerCredential() method

Initiate a new credential exchange as issuer by sending a credential offer message to the connection with the specified connection id.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
offerCredential(connectionId: string, credentialTemplate: CredentialOfferTemplate): Promise<CredentialRecord>;
```

## Parameters

|  Parameter | Type | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
|  connectionId | string | The connection to send the credential offer to |
|  credentialTemplate | [CredentialOfferTemplate](./core.credentialoffertemplate.md) | The credential template to use for the offer |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;[CredentialRecord](./core.credentialrecord.md)<!-- -->&gt;
